title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings: reproducibility artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings. Version 1.3.0 groups code, data, results, paper and documentation in a conventional public layout. An explicit path map preserves 191 frozen scientific/provenance files byte for byte and restores historical execution paths in isolated working copies. Four AI-review reports remain in the immutable v1.2.0 archive. Includes the unchanged V4 manuscript, label-limited audit example, pinned environment and cross-platform CI. Prepared for ESANN 2027 general track; not submitted or accepted. No DOI assigned to 1.3.0. Software BSD-3-Clause, manuscript CC BY 4.0, original template license retained.
